name: Paradise
source:
Sato Kin's life seems to live a happy life.
With Sensible sister
Kind classmate...

He is worrying about something.
He don't think he belong here.
What other things he think he should do is not here.

The teenager decided to leave this place and start traveling.
What is waiting for him, in this unknown trip...

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/789050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
佐藤健的生活似乎过着幸福的生活。
和懂事的姐姐一起
好心的同学…

他正在担心某事。
他认为他不属于这里。
他认为自己应该做的其他事情不在这里。

少年决定离开这个地方，开始旅行。
在这未知的旅途中，等待他的是什么……

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/789050/]Steam[/url]]
